class.name: rqt_marine_sonar/MarineEchogram
class.description: Water-column echogram viewer for marine_acoustic_msgs/RawSonarImage. Renders a depth-vs-ping "curtain" from a single-beam sonar or the nadir beam of a multibeam, with mouse-wheel depth zoom and drag pan.

qtgui.label: Marine Echogram
qtgui.statustip: Display a water-column sonar echogram (depth vs. ping).
